listing.name: Retrofitted Bridge v0.0.4
listing.summary: Convert automated ships to crewed ships.
listing.aiSummary: Replaces the automated ship hullmod with a Retrofitted Bridge hullmod for a credit cost, converting the vessel into a crewed ship.

description:
Retrofitted Bridge (v0.0.5)

Convert automated ships to crewed ships.

download here

requires LunaLib

This mods does 1 things

For a substantial credit cost, replace the automated ship hullmod with Retrofitted Bridge hullmod, which turns it into a crewed ship.

img

changelog
v0.0.5 (2026-11-14)
- removed code to make automated ships recoverable by default as that's already in vanilla as of 0.08.5a

v0.0.4 (2025-09-13)
- changed skeleton/maximum crew cost to be more inline with other hullmods
- the orbital works checks now also works with anything that downgrades to orbital works
- compatible with AoTD vaults of knowledge
- you can also simply just turn off the check in data/config/settings.json

v0.0.3 (2025-03-28)
- recompile for for Java 17 and 0.98a-RC5

v0.0.2 (2025-03-18)
- some UI improvements

v0.0.1 (2024-07-01)
- initial release of Retrofitted Bridge

aiDescription: Allows players to convert automated ships into crewed ones by replacing their automation hullmod. This conversion requires paying a substantial credit cost and results in a ship that operates with a full crew.

gallery.aiCaption: A refit screen showing a ship with the 'Remove Automated Ship' option and text about replacing it with a Retrofitted Bridge.
A refit screen displaying the 'Retrofitted Bridge' hullmod description and its effects on crew and storage.
